name: View
description: Base class for a view. An application subclasses it as OGX.Views.Name and places that class in a route.
access: Define require('Views.Name', 'View') and OGX.Views.Name, then construct(this, 'Views.Name'). A route addresses it as selector:Views.Name. Method names are not OML keys.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Id of the view. When omitted, OGX sets data-ogx-id. An id that starts with # is written as the element id. Optional.

properties.name: observe
properties.description: Mutation observer. Defaults to false. Optional.

properties.name: scroll
properties.description: Creates a Scroller that fills the view. Defaults to false. Optional.

properties.name: overlay
properties.description: Shows an overlay at start. Defaults to false. Optional.

properties.name: loading
properties.description: Shows a loading indicator at start. Defaults to false. Optional.

properties.name: html
properties.description: HTML rendered in the view. Optional.

properties.name: template
properties.description: Name of a template preloaded in OGX.Templater. Optional.

properties.name: css
properties.description: CSS class added to the view element. Avoid a class that changes display when the view sits in a Scroller or a Carousel. Optional.

properties.name: data
properties.description: Passed to the view constructor. A template reads it as {{$property}}. Optional.

catalog_status: Listed fields are OML config from the OGX.JS wiki. Methods are not listed. Use inherited true for documented base classes. Do not invent members that are absent.
